image_description: The image displays two bison in a grassy, natural environment. One bison is standing prominently in the mid-ground, facing left, showcasing its massive shoulder hump, shaggy dark brown fur, and head profile. A second bison is lying down in the foreground, partially obscured by tall grass and vegetation, with only its back and rear visible. The background consists of a green slope with scattered trees.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The standing bison clearly shows a large, broad head. While the horns are small and partially blended with the fur, the characteristic shape and curvature typical of a bison are visible on the top of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, dark beard of long hair is visible hanging from the chin and throat area of the standing bison.
The eye of the standing bison is visible as a dark spot on the side of its head, consistent with the description.
No prominent ears are sticking out; the ear region appears covered by the thick, shaggy fur of the head, matching the 'hidden in fur' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The standing bison exhibits a massive, heavy build with a very high shoulder line (withers) that slopes down towards the hindquarters, a key anatomical feature of bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark brown fur, creating a very prominent, rounded shoulder hump.
The fur on the rear half of the standing bison is visibly shorter and smoother compared to the dense shagginess of the front half.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are small, curved, and black, appearing quite short relative to the massive size of the bison's head and body.
The lower legs and feet of the standing bison are obscured by tall grass and the angle of the terrain. The hooves are not visible.
The tail is visible hanging down at the rear of the standing bison, ending in a distinct dark, bushy tuft.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification (Bison bison) and rule out look-alikes like cattle or yak based on fine-grained visual features.
To verify the structural integrity of the four legs and the connection of the head to the body, ensuring no limb fusion or extra limbs despite the grass occlusion.
To check for 'melting' artifacts where the shaggy fur meets the background grass, a common failure mode in AI-generated animals with complex textures.
To assess general texture consistency and lighting coherence between the two animals and the environment.

focus_areas: Fur texture consistency and edge definition against background
Anatomical correctness of the shoulder hump and leg placement
Structural plausibility of the recumbent bison in the foreground
